Cuts the features of a vector to the area of the polygons of another vector, keeping their attributes.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** JTS, Clip, Vector<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorClipper`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | vector file |  |  | The vector to clip: points, lines or polygons. |
| `inClipper` | vector file |  |  | The polygons to clip with. |
